title: Advanced passive / reporting
note: impersonal it is said / is believed / have been found · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: It is said that the company will expand.
items.cz: Říká se, že se firma rozšíří.
items.gap: It ____ said that the company will expand.
accepts: It is said that the company will expand.
items.explanation: Impersonal passive: It is said that…
items.explanation_cz: Neosobní pasiv: It is said that…

items.en: The president is believed to be resigning.
items.gap: The president is believed ____ be resigning.
accepts: The president is believed to be resigning.

items.en: It has been suggested that we delay.
items.gap: It has been ____ that we delay.
accepts: It has been suggested that we delay.

items.en: She is thought to have left the country.
items.cz: Má se za to, že opustila zemi.
items.gap: She is thought to ____ left the country.
accepts: She is thought to have left the country.

items.en: It is widely assumed that demand will rise.
items.cz: Široce se předpokládá, že poptávka stoupne.
items.gap: It is widely ____ that demand will rise.
accepts: It is widely assumed that demand will rise.

items.en: They are reported to be in talks.
items.gap: They are reported ____ be in talks.
accepts: They are reported to be in talks.

items.en: It was claimed that the data were false.
items.cz: Tvrdilo se, že data byla falešná.
items.gap: It was ____ that the data were false.
accepts: It was claimed that the data were false.

items.en: He is known to have worked abroad.
items.cz: Je známo, že pracoval v zahraničí.
items.gap: He is known to ____ worked abroad.
accepts: He is known to have worked abroad.

items.en: It should be noted that costs rose.
items.cz: Je třeba poznamenat, že náklady stouply.
items.gap: It should be ____ that costs rose.
accepts: It should be noted that costs rose.

items.en: The results are expected to improve.
items.cz: Očekává se, že se výsledky zlepší.
accepts: The results are expected to improve.
